newsitem.title: SPAIN: Telefonica to take legal action on Romanian awards.
newsitem.headline: Telefonica to take legal action on Romanian awards.

text.p: Spanish telecommunications operator Telefonica said on Friday that its international arm would take legal action over the failure of its Telefonica Romania to win one of two licences in Romania for the award of a digital cellular phone networks.

In a brief statement, Telefonica Internacional (TISA), majority shareholder in Telefonica Romania, said "it considered that the resolution adopted by the current acting government of Romania to not grant this company one of the two licences for operating a system of GSM mobile telephones, violates the rights conceded at that time (March 1992) to Telefonica Romania."
"Telefonica Internacion will launch appropriate legal action before the appropriate international authority to ensure that its rights are recognised and protected," the statement said.
Earlier on Friday, the Romanian Communications Ministry said it had awarded the two licences to AirTouch Communications Inc and to France Telecom.
